response.sql:
WITH award_winners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, p.bats
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS manager_count
    FROM award_winners
    GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats AS batting_hand,
       manager_count,
       CAST(manager_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share_of_winning_managers
FROM hand_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A blank or missing batting hand is represented by NULL or an empty string in bats; these are grouped separately as stored. Distinct winners are counted by player_id across all manager award records.
